title: Visual explanations for book and studies
question: How should we add UML and sequence diagrams to the book and study documentation so the explanations are more visual, accurate, and maintainable?
decision_criteria: Improve reader comprehension of design structure and behavior
Stay faithful to committed designs and label illustration versus measured evidence
Keep diagram sources and rendering reproducible in Podman
Prioritize the highest-value book and study pages without duplicating visuals
